name: Affiliate intake screen — applications to outreach draft or owner alert (demo)

parameters.content:
## Screen affiliate applications against editable rules, then draft outreach or alert the owner

**Who it's for:** affiliate/ambassador program owners who want every application screened against their own rules — without reviewing each one by hand.

**How it works:** a manual trigger (demo) loads a batch of applications, dedupes by email, sanity-checks self-reported metrics, then scores each applicant against an editable RULES block. Qualified applicants get a personalized outreach draft; everyone else becomes a reason-coded owner alert. A Merge node joins both branches so every run ends with exactly one owner digest — "N qualified, M alert(s)".

**Setup:** ~2 minutes, zero credentials. Import, click Test workflow — the bundled intake emits 6 sample applications including a missing-email row, an implausible-metrics row, a duplicate and a below-threshold applicant, so both branches run immediately.

**Requirements:** none for demo mode. Production swaps the demo intake for a real form (Tally/Typeform/webhook) and adds Sheets/Gmail.

**Customize:** edit the RULES block in Validate + dedupe + score; point Alert and Digest at Slack or email.

*Sample build — internal demo, not client work.*

### Trigger — the demo entry point

**Manual** runs the bundled demo batch. Production swap: replace the trigger + demo intake with a Tally/Typeform webhook or an n8n Form Trigger that emits the same item shape — everything downstream stays untouched.

### The demo path needs no credential

The intake is a Code node, not an API call — the template runs end-to-end on import, with the dirty rows that exercise the failure branch.

Production swap: keep the output shape (`name`, `email`, `platform`, `handle`, `followers`, `engagement_rate`, `posts`, `niche`).

### Two branches, one digest

Qualified applicants get an outreach draft; everyone else is a reason-coded owner alert — never a silent drop.

### Exactly one digest per run

Merge must sit BEFORE this node and the node must be `runOnceForAllItems` — otherwise the digest fires once per branch or once per item.
